==Description==
'''Battlepass Boost''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that boosts pass currency gained by 50% on every map when manually activated by the developers.

==Effects==
When active, '''Battlepass Boost''' will increase pass currency drops by 50%. Previously, it boosted it by 100%.
